Mzero | C++ RUST Bitcoin | Miami, United States| Full-time | ONSITE - Miami, FL

Mzero is hiring a core protocol engineer for its Char Network in its Miami, Florida office.

Mzero's chief product is the Char Network. The Char Network is a (to be) open-sourced sequencer for Layer 2s secured by Bitcoin via a unique proof of stake mechanism.

We are looking for experienced Rust, C++, and Bitcoin devs interested in in-person collaboration with a small team of inspiring, clever, and fun engineers as they explore the boundaries of what is possible to do on Bitcoin.

Apply here https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/charnetwork/jobs/4055702009
